provenance.shot: Rear camera, character running toward temple, approximately 22–25 seconds
provenance.frame_numbering: Zero-based ffprobe decoded frame order, not a player timecode
provenance.landmark: Same viewer-right foot heel-raised/sole-visible phase; ground contact is obscured
provenance.review: Independently inspected by critic_motion_reference using original-resolution crops; 16–17 frames per full same-foot cycle. An initial 13-frame hypothesis was rejected.
limitations: Pre-release promotional source: container creation timestamp is 2016-10-20, before retail release.
Encoding cadence is not proof of unique gameplay frame rate or unaltered real-time playback.
Run versus sprint, controller input timing, platform and build are unknown; HUD is hidden.
Five adjacent cycles in one shot, not five independent controlled trials.
Tolerance is a conservative visual annotation allowance, not a statistical confidence interval.
No inference about world speed, acceleration, stopping, jump physics, or input latency.
provenance.method: Mean of 5 adjacent phase-center PTS differences from supplied manual windows. See annotation review field for review provenance.

gait_cycle_s.note: Visible gait animation in one prerelease shot; locomotion mode and playback speed unverified. Do not tune physics or assert matching feel from this.
